data.name: Non-Disclosure Agreement
data.description: A one-way NDA for sharing confidential information with a partner, investor or contractor.
data.disclaimer: This document is a draft template provided for convenience and is not legal advice. Cofoundaz is not a law firm. Have a qualified lawyer review it before you sign or rely on it.

sections.heading: Parties
sections.value: This Non-Disclosure Agreement is made on 2026-10-25 between NovaPay (the "Disclosing Party") and [Receiving party] (the "Receiving Party").

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.value: The Disclosing Party will share confidential information with the Receiving Party solely for the following purpose: [Purpose of sharing]. The Receiving Party may not use the information for any other purpose.

sections.heading: Confidential Information
sections.value: "Confidential Information" means any non-public information the Disclosing Party shares in any form, including business plans, financials, customer and supplier details, product designs, source code and know-how, whether or not it is marked confidential.

sections.heading: Obligations of the Receiving Party
sections.value: The Receiving Party will: keep the Confidential Information secret using at least the care it uses for its own confidential material; share it only with people who need to know it for the purpose above and who are bound by equivalent duties; and not copy it except as the purpose requires.

sections.heading: Exclusions
sections.value: These duties do not apply to information that: is or becomes public through no fault of the Receiving Party; was already known to the Receiving Party without a duty of confidence; is received lawfully from a third party; or must be disclosed by law, in which case the Receiving Party will give the Disclosing Party prompt notice where allowed.

sections.heading: Term
sections.value: This agreement covers information shared from the effective date. The duties of confidentiality continue for 2 years after the effective date.

sections.heading: Return or Destruction
sections.value: On request, the Receiving Party will promptly return or destroy all Confidential Information and confirm in writing that it has done so.

sections.heading: Remedies
sections.value: The Receiving Party acknowledges that a breach may cause harm that money alone cannot repair, and that the Disclosing Party may seek an injunction in addition to any other remedy.

sections.heading: Governing Law
sections.value: This agreement is governed by the laws of [Governing law], and its courts have jurisdiction over any dispute.
